title: Company Answers: a cited Q&A page on your own content
description: The hello-world of Glean apps: one page, one input, one permission-aware cited answer — built two ways, with the Web SDK and with the Chat API.

preview.alt: Company Answers showing a grounded response with source citations
preview.caption: A permission-aware answer grounded in company knowledge.

prerequisites: A Glean instance with content indexed
For the Web SDK path: an existing Glean session in your normal browser

demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Returns a non-empty answer with at least one citation carrying a real title and URL, drawn from your own indexed content.

demoQueries.query: How do I request time off?

codeAssets.description: Web SDK variant — renderChat in a page

questions.prompt: What is your work email? It is used once to discover your Glean tenant.
What topic do you know exists in your Glean content?

run.url: the Local URL printed by Vite

steps.title: Configure the tenant
steps.description: Enter the user's work email when prompted. The shipped discovery command writes VITE_GLEAN_BACKEND to .env.local. Set VITE_GLEAN_INITIAL_MESSAGE to the topic they supplied.

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Give the user the exact printed local URL to open in their normal signed-in browser. Ask them to try a topic they know exists in their Glean instance and confirm a real, cited answer renders inside Glean's chat UI.

codeAssets.description: Chat API variant — one chat.create call, citations rendered

questions.prompt: What is your work email? It is used once to discover your Glean tenant.
What topic do you know exists in your Glean content?

run.url: the Local URL printed by the server

steps.title: Set credentials
steps.description: The shipped command discovers the tenant from the user's work email, signs them in with OAuth, and writes the backend plus short-lived access token to ignored .env. Set GLEAN_DEMO_QUERY to the supplied topic. If tenant OAuth is unavailable, enter a CHAT-scoped API token as the fallback.

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Takes about 1–3 minutes. It starts its own server and checks the configured topic for a non-empty answer with deduplicated citations.

steps.title: Pick a path
steps.description: Path A (Web SDK) renders Glean's own chat UI for you — fastest to stand up, no backend code. Path B (Chat API) calls the Chat API directly from your own backend — you own every pixel of the UI and the request/response shape. Both reach the same place: a permission-aware, cited answer.

aiPrompt: Build Company Answers following https://developers.glean.com/cookbook/company-answers. Ask whether to use (A) Web SDK or (B) Chat API. Path A requires the tenant's HTTPS backend origin and a topic the user knows exists; pass the backend explicitly to renderChat, start Vite, report its exact URL, and wait for the user to verify it in their normal signed-in browser without browser automation. Path B keeps the CHAT-scoped token server-side, calls glean.client.chat.create, joins CONTENT fragments, and renders deduplicated fragment citations. Verify a tenant-relevant cited answer and do not claim a live check without the user's result.
llmContext: Path A uses renderChat with an explicit backend and the user's existing Glean browser session; live verification is user-mediated in their normal signed-in browser. Path B constructs Glean with apiToken plus instance or serverURL, reads answer text only from CONTENT messages, collects citations from fragment.citation.sourceDocument, deduplicates by URL, keeps the token server-side, sets saveChat:false for verification, and treats an empty joined answer as retryable.

content.problem:
Every team has the same first Glean app: a single page where anyone can ask
a company question and get a cited, permission-aware answer. There are two
equally valid ways to build it — this recipe builds both, side by side, so
you can pick the trade-off that fits your app.
takeItFurther: Swap in a specific agent by passing its `agentId` — to the chat component for Path A, or in the `chat.create` request for Path B.
Stream responses instead of waiting for the full answer (both the Web SDK and the Chat API support streaming).
Add follow-up prompt suggestions from the Chat API response's `followUpPrompts`.
